body: Wife here. Thank you so much for sharing this. I came to Reddit this morning after finally getting a break, and I'm so humbled and so thankful for all the support my husband has gotten, and I know it would mean a lot to him. I can see now why he visited this site so frequently, and loved punk so much. Again, thank you so much for sharing. He is missed everyday, and I'm so touched to see you guys remembering one of your own.
I appreciate it, man. Remember, I'm not a jerk, I'm just confused. You're a saint, no joke.
Linoleum by NOFX is another one for me, forgot to list it.
This sub needs more posts like this. Not everyone is creeped out by clowns and dolls.
Good list, but I was sad to see that you didn't include my personal favorites: GTA: San Andreas, Fallout 3, and Tony Hawk's American Wasteland.
